fr.label: Finance et comptabilité
fr.description: Rapprochements, budget, relances, clôtures mensuelles, TVA et notes de frais.

en.label: Finance and accounting
en.description: Reconciliations, budget, payment reminders, month-end closing, VAT and expense claims.

fr.text: Chaque chiffre est cité depuis sa pièce (document et ligne ou page) ; aucun montant n'est inventé ni estimé, et tout calcul est montré.

en.text: Every figure is quoted from its source document (document and line or page); no amount is invented or estimated, and every calculation is shown.

guardrails.agent: Quote every amount, rate and date from a named document with its line or page; show every computed figure with its calculation (« 12'400.00 - 11'950.00 = 450.00 »); when a figure is missing, leave it empty and say so — never estimate, round silently or fill a gap with a plausible value.

fr.text: L'agent ne passe ni écriture, ni paiement : il prépare, la personne responsable contrôle et comptabilise.

en.text: The agent books nothing and pays nothing: it prepares, the person in charge checks and books.

guardrails.agent: Never present an entry, a payment, a write-off or a VAT figure as booked or filed: present it as a proposal for the accountant, and list under « Points to confirm » every entry or account it assumes.

fr.text: Les écarts sont signalés, jamais compensés : un total qui ne tombe pas juste reste visible avec sa différence.

en.text: Differences are flagged, never offset: a total that does not match stays visible with its difference.

guardrails.agent: When two documents disagree (invoice and statement, budget and actuals, receipt and claim), show both amounts and the difference; never adjust a figure to make a total balance, and never treat a difference as rounding unless it is below CHF 0.05.

fr.text: Les chiffres de l'entreprise restent dans un projet « Projet » avec le modèle local ; les questions fiscales sont confirmées par la fiduciaire.

en.text: The company's figures stay in a « Project » project with the local model; tax questions are confirmed by the fiduciary.

guardrails.agent: Use VAT rates, tax rules and account numbers only as given in the documents or the team's memory, and present any tax treatment as a question for the fiduciary or the accountant, never as a tax opinion.

fr.label: Rapprochement factures / relevé
fr.hint: Quel compte, quelle période ? Ex. « Rapprocher les factures fournisseurs d'octobre avec le relevé bancaire d'octobre »
fr.attach: Le relevé bancaire ou postal, la liste des factures (ouvertes ou payées), éventuellement le grand livre
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : facture, fournisseur ou client, montant facturé, montant payé, date de paiement, écart, statut, source
checks: Les paiements sans facture et les factures sans paiement

en.label: Invoice / statement reconciliation
en.description: What is paid, what is missing
en.hint: Which account, which period? E.g. “Reconcile October supplier invoices with the October bank statement”
en.attach: The bank or postal statement, the list of invoices (open or paid), the ledger if useful
en.produces: An Excel table: invoice, supplier or customer, amount invoiced, amount paid, payment date, difference, status, source
checks: Payments without invoice and invoices without payment

templates.mission:
Reconcile invoices with a bank or postal statement. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: N° facture, Tiers, Date facture, Montant facturé (CHF), Date paiement, Montant payé (CHF), Écart (CHF), Statut, Source, À vérifier. Match each statement line to an invoice by reference, then by amount and party; a match on amount only is marked « À vérifier ». Status is one of « payée », « payée partiellement », « non payée », « paiement sans facture », « doublon ». The difference is computed (paid - invoiced) and labelled as computed; end with labelled total rows for invoiced, paid and difference.

fr.label: Commentaire budget vs réel
fr.hint: Quelle période, pour qui ? Ex. « Commentaire des écarts budget/réel à fin octobre pour le conseil d'administration »
fr.attach: Le budget, l'état des comptes de la période (balance, compte de résultat), les explications reçues des responsables
fr.produces: Un rapport : synthèse, tableau des postes avec budget, réel, écart en CHF et en %, explication de chaque écart significatif, points d'attention
checks: Le seuil d'écart retenu comme significatif

en.label: Budget vs actual commentary
en.hint: Which period, for whom? E.g. “Budget/actual variance commentary at end October for the board”
en.attach: The budget, the period's accounts (trial balance, income statement), the explanations received from managers
en.produces: A report: summary, table of lines with budget, actual, variance in CHF and %, explanation of each significant variance, points of attention

templates.mission:
Write the budget vs actual commentary of a period. What the person asked for: {subject}

Build a table per line (revenue, main cost groups, result) with budget, actual, variance in CHF and in %, each variance computed and labelled. Comment every variance above the threshold in the team's memory, or above 10 % and CHF 5'000.00 when none is set (say which threshold you used). Explain a variance only with what the documents say; otherwise write « explication à obtenir de … ». When the budget covers the year and the actuals a part of it, say how you prorated, or that you did not. End with the points of attention for the rest of the year.

fr.label: Relance de paiement
fr.hint: Quel client, quel niveau ? Ex. « Deuxième rappel à la société Exemple SA pour les factures 2026-118 et 2026-131 »
fr.attach: Les factures impayées, le relevé du compte client, les rappels déjà envoyés
fr.produces: Une lettre de rappel avec le détail des factures dues, le total, le nouveau délai et les coordonnées de paiement à compléter
checks: Les factures, montants et échéances listés
Le niveau de rappel et les frais éventuels
Que le paiement n'est pas déjà arrivé

en.label: Payment reminder
en.hint: Which customer, which level? E.g. “Second reminder to Example Ltd for invoices 2026-118 and 2026-131”
en.attach: The unpaid invoices, the customer account statement, reminders already sent
en.produces: A reminder letter with the invoices due, the total, the new deadline and payment details to complete
checks: The invoices, amounts and due dates listed
The reminder level and any fees
That payment has not already arrived

templates.mission:
Draft a payment reminder. What the person asked for: {subject}

List each unpaid invoice with its number, date, due date and amount as written, and the total with its computation. Match the tone to the level: a first reminder assumes an oversight, a second sets a firm deadline, a last one announces the next step the team's memory names. Add late fees or interest only when the person asks for them and the documents give the rate. Leave the payment details as « [coordonnées de paiement] » unless the memory gives them.

fr.label: Note de clôture mensuelle
fr.hint: Quel mois, pour qui ? Ex. « Note de clôture d'octobre pour la direction, avec la trésorerie »
fr.attach: La balance ou le compte de résultat du mois, la trésorerie, la liste des débiteurs et créanciers, vos notes de clôture
fr.produces: Une note : chiffres clés du mois, trésorerie, débiteurs en retard, écritures de régularisation proposées, points ouverts
checks: Les chiffres clés, contre la balance
Les points ouverts et leur responsable

en.label: Month-end closing note
en.hint: Which month, for whom? E.g. “October closing note for management, with cash position”
en.attach: The month's trial balance or income statement, the cash position, the receivables and payables lists, your closing notes
en.produces: A note: key figures of the month, cash, overdue receivables, proposed accruals, open points
checks: Key figures, against the trial balance

templates.mission:
Write the month-end closing note. What the person asked for: {subject}

Start with five key figures of the month (revenue, gross margin, personnel costs, result, cash at month end), each with its source line and, when the documents give it, the previous month or the budget. Then: receivables overdue by more than 30 days (party, amount, days), payables due in the next 30 days, accruals and deferrals proposed with their basis, and the open points. Every proposed entry is a proposal for the accountant, with the accounts left « [à définir] » unless the memory gives the chart of accounts.

fr.label: Préparation du décompte TVA
fr.hint: Quel trimestre, quelle méthode ? Ex. « Préparer le décompte TVA du 3e trimestre 2026, méthode effective »
fr.attach: Le journal des ventes, le journal des achats ou les factures fournisseurs, le dernier décompte
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : opération, date, montant HT, taux, TVA due ou impôt préalable, chiffre du formulaire concerné, source
checks: Les taux appliqués à chaque ligne
Les totaux par chiffre du décompte

en.label: VAT return preparation
en.hint: Which quarter, which method? E.g. “Prepare the Q3 2026 VAT return, effective method”
en.attach: The sales journal, the purchase journal or supplier invoices, the last return
en.produces: An Excel table: transaction, date, net amount, rate, VAT due or input tax, return box concerned, source
checks: The rate applied to each line

templates.mission:
Prepare the figures of a VAT return. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Type (vente/achat), Date, Pièce, Tiers, Montant HT (CHF), Taux (%), TVA (CHF), Montant TTC (CHF), Chiffre du décompte, Source, À vérifier. Use only the rates and return boxes given in the documents or the team's memory. Recompute the VAT of each line from the net amount and the rate; when it differs from the invoice by more than CHF 0.05, mark the row « À vérifier ». Mark also every line whose deductibility is doubtful (private use, entertainment, foreign invoice). End with labelled total rows per return box and the computed balance due or refundable.

fr.label: Contrôle des notes de frais
fr.hint: Quelle période, qui ? Ex. « Contrôler les notes de frais de novembre de l'équipe de vente selon notre règlement »
fr.attach: Les notes de frais, les justificatifs, le règlement des frais
fr.produces: Un tableau Excel : collaborateur·trice, date, nature, montant demandé, justificatif, plafond, montant admis, écart, motif, source
checks: Les dépenses refusées ou réduites et leur motif

en.label: Expense claim check
en.hint: Which period, whom? E.g. “Check the November expense claims of the sales team against our policy”
en.attach: The expense claims, the receipts, the expense policy
en.produces: An Excel table: employee, date, type, amount claimed, receipt, cap, amount allowed, difference, reason, source
checks: Expenses refused or reduced and why

templates.mission:
Check expense claims against the policy. What the person asked for: {subject}

Columns: Collaborateur·trice, Date, Nature, Montant demandé (CHF), Justificatif (oui/non), Plafond (CHF), Montant admis (CHF), Écart (CHF), Motif, Source, À vérifier. Compare each line with its receipt and with the cap of the expense policy, quoting the rule in Motif. A line without a receipt, above a cap, on a weekend or duplicated in another claim is marked « À vérifier »; the amount allowed is a proposal, not a decision. End with labelled totals per employee and overall.

fr.label: Check-list de clôture
fr.hint: Quelle clôture ? Ex. « Check-list de clôture annuelle 2026, avec les documents à remettre à la fiduciaire »
fr.attach: Votre plan comptable, l'ancienne check-list, la liste demandée par la fiduciaire ou l'organe de révision
fr.produces: Une check-list par étape : rapprochements, inventaire, régularisations, amortissements, TVA, salaires, pièces à remettre, avec responsables et échéances
checks: Les documents demandés par la fiduciaire

en.label: Closing checklist
en.hint: Which closing? E.g. “Year-end 2026 closing checklist, with the papers to hand to the fiduciary”
en.attach: Your chart of accounts, the previous checklist, the list requested by the fiduciary or auditor
en.produces: A checklist by step: reconciliations, inventory, accruals, depreciation, VAT, payroll, papers to hand over, with owners and deadlines
checks: The papers requested by the fiduciary

templates.mission:
Prepare a closing checklist. What the person asked for: {subject}

Group the items by phase: before closing, reconciliations (bank, receivables, payables, VAT, social insurance), period-end entries (accruals, deferrals, depreciation, provisions), inventory, reporting, papers for the fiduciary or auditor. Each item starts with a verb and names the owner, the deadline and the proof (reconciliation, list, signed report). Take every item requested by the fiduciary from its list, quoting it; items from good practice are marked « (bonne pratique) ».

fr.label: Circuit de validation des factures
fr.hint: Pour quelles factures ? Ex. « Procédure de validation des factures fournisseurs, avec les seuils de signature »
fr.attach: Votre règlement des compétences ou de signature, l'ancienne procédure, les outils utilisés
fr.produces: Une procédure : réception, contrôle, visa, approbation selon les seuils, saisie, paiement, archivage, avec responsables
checks: La séparation entre qui approuve et qui paie

en.label: Invoice approval workflow
en.hint: For which invoices? E.g. “Supplier invoice approval procedure, with signing thresholds”
en.attach: Your delegation of authority or signature rules, the previous procedure, the tools in use
en.produces: A procedure: receipt, check, initialling, approval by threshold, booking, payment, archiving, with owners
checks: Separation between who approves and who pays

templates.mission:
Write the approval procedure for incoming invoices. What the person asked for: {subject}

Number the steps from receipt to archiving, one action per step with its actor and expected result. Take the approval thresholds and signatories from the documents, as a table (amount band, who approves); when none is given, write « [à définir] » rather than a usual value. Make sure the person who approves an invoice is not the only one who releases its payment, and flag it when the documents allow it. Add what to do with a disputed invoice, a credit note and an invoice received without an order.

- Plan comptable de référence : [À compléter : ex. PME suisse, adapté]
